headline: SO WHY DON'T WE GET CRUSHED?
AIR PUSHES FROM EVERY SIDE

package.title: How Much Does The Sky Weigh?
alt_titles: The Air Above Your Head Weighs A Tonne
You're Carrying A Tonne Of Air Right Now
description: Air has weight. At sea level the column of air above every square metre weighs about 10.3 tonnes (101,325 Pa ÷ g).
The whole atmosphere weighs about 5.15 quadrillion tonnes (5.15 × 10¹⁸ kg). We don't get crushed because air presses equally from every side, including from the air and fluids inside us.
package.question: Which one surprised you? 👇
package.pinned: The air above your phone screen weighs about as much as a person. Air pressure: 101,325 Pa at sea level 🌍
package.tiktok: How much does the sky weigh? The air above your head alone is about a tonne 🤯 #science #physics
package.reels: The sky weighs 5 quadrillion tonnes. So why don't we get crushed? 🌍 Follow @packedbuh for more #science #physics
